moments.text: Infrared view of a plain grey background with two vertical tracking bars at centre. A small dark blob sits between them and stays centred.
The view zooms in steadily: the bars spread apart and the dark shape grows, showing an upper and a lower lobe with small bright points.
Close up, the shape fills the bars: a cluster of dark lobes with several bright spots on its left and lower side.
The shape slides out of the bars toward the upper left while the bars spread wider apart.
The image smears with horizontal streaks, the shape exits at the upper-left edge, and only the empty bars remain.
